description: The figure illustrates training rewards over optimization steps for two methods on two datasets, shown as two stacked line plots titled “Easy Training Set” (top) and “Hard Training Set” (bottom). Both plots share the same x-axis labeled “Steps” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with major ticks at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. Both y-axes are labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale; in the top plot the labeled ticks include 0.0 and 0.2 (with values extending above 0.2), and in the bottom plot the labeled ticks include 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2. In the Easy Training Set plot, a blue solid line (legend: “Llama-On-Policy-Easy”) rises from near 0 at step 0 to roughly 0.2 by about 80–100 steps, then continues upward with fluctuations to around the low-to-mid 0.3 range by ~200 steps, and ends near the mid 0.3 range by step 500; a red solid line (legend: “Llama-LUFFY-Easy”) similarly starts near 0, reaches about 0.2 by ~60–100 steps, continues increasing with small oscillations, and ends slightly higher, around the upper 0.3 range by step 500. In the Hard Training Set plot, a blue solid line (legend: “Llama-On-Policy-Hard”) starts slightly above 0 (around a few hundredths) and declines toward 0 by roughly 80–120 steps, remaining near 0 through the rest of the shown steps; a red solid line (legend: “Llama-LUFFY-Hard”) starts near 0, increases to about 0.1 by ~60–100 steps, continues rising with noticeable fluctuations around ~0.12–0.18 through ~200–400 steps, and ends near about 0.2 by step 500.
